_protocol: R-041B named mean-flux sensitivity test on the REAL high-z spectra: the same single-injection design as the fiducial with halved trials, built once per alternative effective-optical-depth model (forest signal rescaled by exp(-(tau_alt - tau_fid)) through the smooth signal estimate; noise/ivar/mask/coverage/resolution untouched), then the corrected DLA injection. Models: fiducial = the deployed finder's mean-flux suppression (tau0 0.00246, beta 3.62); fg2008 (lower transmission at z ~ 4-5); becker2013. No invented curves. Separate from the fiducial calibration; never combined into a total error.
_compute: 265 per stratum x 5 = 1325 injections per model; 2 models -> 2650 spectra -> ~120 CPU-h
